question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

It is 2036. Looking back, 5 landmark papers each settled this question in a way that surprised the field, because of how they approached it. For each paper, describe what it measured, analyzed, or did, as a concrete idea a research lab could pursue today. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation after priming separates writing from maintaining memory
ideas.description: Tag endogenous FOS/JUN family members with degron systems and deplete them only after a priming stimulus has resolved, then re-stimulate. If primed accessibility and faster re-induction persist without AP-1 present during the interval, AP-1 writes the memory but does not store it.

ideas.title: Lineage-barcoded clonal tracking of AP-1 state heritability
ideas.description: Combine clonal barcoding with paired single-cell ATAC and RNA readouts to quantify how strongly AP-1 motif accessibility and target expression are shared among sibling cells across many divisions. The decay of within-clone similarity over generations gives a direct half-life for the putative memory.

ideas.title: Mitotic bookmarking imaging of AP-1 through division
ideas.description: Live-image endogenously tagged AP-1 subunits with single-molecule residence-time measurement through mitosis, paired with mitotic-chromosome ATAC. Determine whether a subset of sites retains bound factor or open chromatin through condensation, which is the physical requirement for passing the state to daughters.

ideas.title: Motif-resolution epigenome editing at primed AP-1 sites
ideas.description: Use targeted editing or CRISPRi tiling to disrupt individual AP-1 motifs within primed enhancers without touching the factor itself, then test the second-stimulus response. This distinguishes site-specific memory elements from a global AP-1 dosage effect.

ideas.title: Dose-and-interval mapping of memory decay in single cells
ideas.description: Systematically vary stimulus strength, duration, and the gap before re-stimulation, reading out per-cell response amplitude and AP-1 site accessibility. Fitting the resulting surface tests whether the system behaves like a bistable switch, a slowly decaying analog trace, or simple residual protein.
